specials.title: Red Dog Piney Creek Specials
specials.description:
Appetizers:

Burrata Cheese & Roasted Heirloom Tomatoes.
Creamy burrata cheese, covered with roasted heirloom
tomatoes, basil and drizzled with balsamic fig glaze. Served
with toasted crostini ...16

Cowboy Caviar.
Black eyed peas, black beans, tomatoes, onion, corn and
cilantro, in a bright, tangy dressing. Served with crispy tortilla
chips ... 13

Entrées:

Baby Back Rribs.
Juicy, fall-off-the-bone baby back ribs slathered in our house
made BBQ sauce. Served with baked beans, cole slaw and
fries … half rack 32 … whole rack 42

Maryland Crab Cakes.
Crab cakes Maryland style, served on a bed of lemon caper
pasta with roasted asparagus ... 45

Grilled Portabella Mushroom Burger.
Portabella mushroom cap marinated, grilled, then topped
with melted provolone cheese, grilled onions, tomato,
spinach, and avocado spread. Served with fries …16

Dessert:
Strawberry Tiramisu. Layers of ladyfingers, cream cheese, whipped cream
and fresh strawberries ... 10

LUNCH SPECIALS
Friday, Saturday, Sunday 11 AM-3 PM

“2 Dog Deal”. 2 all-beef, Nathan’s dogs, in
steamed buns topped with chili, slaw, yellow
mustard, and finely chopped raw onions.
Served with fries ... 13

Kyler’s Jalapeño Onion Smashburger. Our
signature beef blend smashed, topped with
grilled jalapeños, onions, a smidge of house
BBQ sauce, pepper jack cheese, Red Dog burger
sauce, lettuce and tomato. Served with fries …16
